{{Quote|The Republic moved before we did, sending a full fleet to Oricon. Its armada was undone by the Masters' powers of fear and madness. Our task force followed--a rapid strike deployment led by one Lord Hargrev, upon the insistence of Darth Rictus. Hargrev is a braggart and a sadist, but he has studied our foe. He believed that he and his acolytes could shield our task force from the Masters' power.|Darth Marr explains the situation on Oricon to Imperial heroes|<ref name="APTM" />}}
The '''Dread Executioners''' were a group of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] and [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] personnel that were dispatched by [[Darth Rictus]] in [[3637 BBY]] to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Oricon]] to eliminate the [[Dread Masters]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Lord [[Hargrev]] was the Sith commander of the organization, with [[Maiya Vix]] as his Imperial military adjutant. They had a [[Dread Executioners camp|camp]] west of the [[Dread Fortress]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Dread Executioners appeared in Game Update 2.4 of the [[BioWare]]-[[LucasArts]] [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a reputation organization for Imperial player characters. Imperial faction player characters could increase their reputation with the unit by completing missions in the Oricon daily area. [[Strike Team Oricon]] was the organization available to Republic faction player characters.<ref name="PN">{{TORweb/Patch|2.4}}</ref>
